messages.subject: Eigen 3.1.1 push
parts:
I updated the Eigen lib to version 3.1.1,
and all unit tests were still passing.

I changed the makefile to match.

I changed the doc to reflect the new version
and new license (MPL 2).

Git figured out many of these new files were
just renamed versions of old ones even though
they moved from lib/eigen_3.1.0 to lib/eigen_3.1.1.
Nice!

- Bob
